items.quote: Southern Roots did a great job on our oak! They came out the same day for a free estimate and had our tree trimmed 2 days later. They supported law enforcement, were friendly, and communicated well. I've included before and after pictures. Now we are ready for hurricane season.

Thank you to Bill and his team for taking care of our property! We had several trees that were overhanging the roof, and we contacted Bill for an estimate before we replaced the roof. ... Bill was so knowledgeable and his price was unbeatable! The crew was so professional and polite and they cleaned up everything ... I see why they were voted the best in the Tampa Bay area because they truly take pride in their work!!

The entire crew did an awesome job from start to finish. They worked hard and safely while taking down several dead trees and some very tall trees (75ft plus) that was extremely close to both my house and my neighbor's house. They took extreme care with the trees near the power lines and handled everything carefully and professionally. The whole team was positive and easy to work with, and their pricing was very fair. Highly recommend!
